blocks.text: The last real port on the Reach: lantern-lit quays, salt-rotted warehouses, and a market where anything can be bought if you don't ask where it surfaced. Governed — nominally — by Magistrate [[Ilsa Corvin]].
The [[The Tidewardens|Tidewardens]] keep a garrison at the harbor chain. Half the town pays tithes to them; the other half pays [[Kestrel Vane]].
Vellen floats on three things: fish, salvage, and secrets. — [[Brother Aldous]]
Cellar walls in the old quarter are older than the town above them. The sealed [[Undercrypt of Maro]] lies below the Lantern Shrine.
The smugglers' tunnel behind the fish market connects to the Undercrypt's outer galleries. Kestrel's crew uses it; the Veiled Hand watches it. If the party buys passage, roll for a tail.
